cases.name: 1. ingest: a provider callback is persisted once per (store, notification_id) and a redelivery dedupes
cases.details: Callback is inserted into monetization.store_notifications; subsequent redelivery is deduplicated via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING with ingested=false.

cases.name: 2. notifications: a claimed callback is leased, a stale owner cannot apply it, and a failure retries with a bounded error
cases.details: Notification claimed with lease and monotonic fence token; stale owner completion rejected; failure retries with exponential backoff and error sanitized <= 280 chars.

cases.name: 3. finalize: Google consume/acknowledge runs only once the granted receipt is committed
cases.details: completeFinalization checks monetization.receipts first; without a durable grant, provider is never called and finalization remains pending; once grant is committed, provider is called and row transitions to state='done'.

cases.name: 4. remint: a duplicate or retried purchase callback for an already-granted transaction never grants again
cases.details: handlePurchaseNotification detects existing receipt or revocation tombstone and returns without calling grantFn (duplicate=true, reminted=false).

cases.name: 5. refund: a trusted refund writes the permanent revocation tombstone, flags the receipt, and blocks finalization
cases.details: Refund notification writes permanent tombstone to monetization.store_revocations, marks receipt refunded=true, and blocks store finalization.

cases.name: 6. recovery: a pending finalization is listed, and a crashed finalizer is reclaimed after its lease and completed
cases.details: listPendingFinalizations exposes pending rows; worker dying mid-lease is reclaimed by peer after lease_until with higher fence; dead worker receives fenceLost.

verification.summary: Provider notification and finalization work extracted into packages/services/provider-workflows.js. Deduplication by provider identity/environment verified; finalization runs strictly after durable receipt grant; duplicate/retried callbacks never remint; refund revocations and worker lease recovery verified across 6 dedicated tests on real PG16.
